comparison.objective: Fit and hand-tighten a yoke regulator onto an oxygen-cylinder valve.
comparison.physical_skill: Align hidden indexing pins and washer, hold the yoke square, and turn a T-screw through regrasping.
comparison.success_condition: Yoke fully seated on both pins, washer aligned, screw tightened to the required resistance, then released and still.
comparison.reason: This is a close generic hold-and-tighten neighbor, but its tested ability is component insertion/alignment followed by clamping. It does not set a continuous mechanism angle, counterhold a coaxial adjustment screw against a jam nut, or verify retained motion over cycles.
